title: uor-agent/web-manifest/1
description: Everything an answer on the website depends on besides the question. Public. Its BLAKE3 kappa label (uor-addr, JCS + NFC) is part of every question key, so a change to any member gives every question a new key.

kernel.description: The agent's holo by the label of its bytes, and the commit whose signed build it is (null only when the operator turned the provenance check off).

corpus.description: The label of {type: corpus, items: <sorted labels of every indexed chunk the kernel serves on the website>}.

model.description: The language model, by the name its provider gives it.

retrieval.description: What retrieval was run with. The similarities are strings, because a label is canonical only over strings and integers.
